_comment: PLACEHOLDER SITE LIST — replace every entry with your own. Position each site in ONE of three ways: offset_frac [x, y] as a fraction of the study half-width (scales with --half-width, so it always lands inside the box); offset_m [x, y] in metres east/north of the study centre; or lon/lat. 'h' is the antenna height above local ground, in metres. Pass this file to fetch_open_scene.py with --towers. Public site data: OpenCellID (CC BY-SA 4.0), or your operator's own registry.
